title: Alexa M3: Account linking with Google sign-in and QR on Echo Show
description:
Milestone 3. A person links their Papyrus account to the skill the standard, certifiable way.

Scope:
- A new Cognito app client on the site's existing user pool, only for Alexa: authorization code grant with PKCE, Google as the only identity provider, a client secret, refresh tokens enabled, and Amazon's redirect URLs (pitangui/layla/alexa.amazon.co.jp) as callbacks. Modelled on amplify/auth/prospectus-google-client.ts. Never email/password users.
- Account linking config in the skill manifest (generated): authorization URI = the site's Cognito hosted UI /oauth2/authorize, token URI /oauth2/token, scopes, PKCE on. Client secret from SSM via IaC.
- Linking is optional. Intents that need a signed-in user send a LinkAccount card. On an Echo Show, Alexa shows its own QR code for linking.
- The skill validates the Cognito access token on every request (issuer, audience/client_id, expiry) and maps it to the Papyrus user and their groups, the same authorization the site uses.
- Unlinking and revoked or expired tokens degrade cleanly to the public experience.

Risks to check first (spike task): Google refuses OAuth inside embedded webviews. Confirm the Alexa app's linking browser and the QR path on a phone both get through Google sign-in through the Cognito hosted UI. Also confirm the hosted UI domain's certificate meets Amazon's CA list (no Let's Encrypt).

Needs Ryan's approval: the Cognito client and backend deploy.

Done when: Ryan scans the Show's QR code, signs in with Google, and the skill greets him by name. Gherkin specs cover linked, unlinked, expired and revoked tokens against a fake JWKS.

Feature: Link my Papyrus account
  Scenario: Link from the Echo Show
    Given I have not linked my account
    When I ask for my feed
    Then the Echo Show shows a QR code to link my account
    And after I sign in with Google on my phone the skill knows who I am
  Scenario: Expired link
    Given my link has been revoked
    When I ask for my feed
    Then I hear the public stories and an offer to link again
